title: Adventure ZMF
description: Full RPG immersion: classes, epic blades, magic, and a completely overhauled world. Your journey starts here.
body:
> ** What does this modpack add?**

- Rogues & Warriors (RPG Series) completely reworks combat and character progression. Choose your path: a nimble rogue or a mighty warrior — each class gets unique abilities and playstyle.
- 
- SlashBlade: Refabricated adds legendary katanas with a deep system of slashes, combos, and animations. Feel like an anime swordsmaster.
- 
- Simply Swords expands your arsenal with dozens of new weapons: daggers, greatswords, glaives, and magical blades with unique effects.
- 
- Spell Engine + Spell Power Attributes introduce a full magic system. Spells scale with your stats — build a mage, paladin, or a tricky archer with enchants.



> ** What are its features?**
> 
- A new dangerous world: William Wythers' Overhauled Overworld completely revamps biome generation. Forests, mountains, wastelands — each region feels unique.
- 
- Horrors & monsters: Rotten Creatures adds eerie mutated creatures. Beware of rotting zombie giants and mummified beasts.
- 
- Improved performance: Sodium + Zoomify — smooth FPS and convenient zoom at any time.
- 
- Maps & navigation: Xaero's Minimap and Xaero's World Map — full world map, waypoints, and even a minimap with entity radar.
- 
- Accessories & gear: Trinkets lets you wear rings, amulets, and other useful baubles (added by other mods).
- 
- Deep customization: YACL and Text Placeholder API let you tweak every detail.



> ** Why would you want to download it?**

1. A complete RPG system out of the box. No need to hunt down 20 mods to make combat interesting. This pack already has classes, spells, and dozens of weapon types.

2. Unique SlashBlade gameplay. If you loved katanas from old modpacks — they work here on the latest 1.21.1 version.

3. A beautiful and dangerous world. William Wythers' biomes look like a modern RPG, and Rotten Creatures' monsters will make you think twice before wandering at night.

4. Stability and performance. Unlike many "heavy" modpacks, this one includes Sodium and optimizations. It won't turn your PC into a furnace.

5. Ready to play solo or on a server. No conflicting mods — everything is tested.
